integrity: The proof separates the infinite argument from regression computation, records the precise weighted-simplex convention, and does not infer novelty from failed search alone.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the Gorenstein canonical non-terminal boundary of weighted projective spaces of the form \\(\\mathbb P(1^r,a,b)\\). The unit-circle exclusion on the odd divisor branch is analytic; the finite checker only verifies the exact floor-sum factorizations and arithmetic parametrization over a large range. Literature searches cannot prove absolute novelty.
title: A divisor criterion for Kronecker \(h^*\)-polynomials on a Gorenstein canonical boundary
